newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices easier as volume falls.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices easier as volume falls.

text.p: Istanbul gold prices eased slightly on Thursday and volume dropped to 1,744 kilos from 1,923 kilos on Wednesday, but free market demand held up relatively well, dealers said.
Gold closed easier at $341.00 an ounce and 1,482,600 lira per gram versus $342.00 and 1,488,000 lira at Wednesday's close, following bearish trends on European markets.
The Turkish currency weakened to 135,590 lira to the dollar from 135,240 at Wednesday's close as the dollar strengthened in world markets.
Dealers said the lower ounce prices and rising dollar also encouraged some arbitrage trade.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,169 kilos -- took place in the morning session, with 80 percent of the total traded in lira terms.
